scope: Kettle Falls Hotel after the National Park Service restoration, with the two-storey L-plan body, south veranda, red roof and eastern lean-to.

originalReview.notes: The original high oblique December 2005 aerial shows the hotel’s roof massing and clearing between the aircraft struts. Small façade details and roof color are obscured by distance and snow.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published Qualla aerial is byte-identical to the National Park Service’s agency original. The original agency record declares full public-domain rights. The aerial supplies context and roof massing while the NPS and National Register descriptions supply the building’s identifiable architecture.
